answer: Vouching with shared liability: a new key joins only when 3 existing keys each lock 50 POA behind it for 30 days. The inlet is the single admission queue, capped at 20 newcomers per epoch, so a fake farm cannot flood in. Each marble is one locked 50 POA stake, and a flagged fake burns all 3 marbles. The quill is the public flag, valid once 5 keys sign it, and it pays each signer 10 POA from the burn. Attacker pays: 20 fakes x 3 x 50 POA = 3,000 POA locked this epoch, 150 POA burned per flagged fake.
